meta.methodology: Read framework.md for classification rules, torah_51_ce_edges.json for cause/effect edges, torah_51_packages.json for existing bechina-based packages, torah_51_additions.json for additional bechina nodes, and torah_51.txt for source text. Collected all node IDs already assigned to packages (22 nodes). Found all unique nodes appearing in cause/effect edges (6 nodes). Identified 4 unassigned nodes. Assigned each to a package by its ESSENTIAL NATURE — what the concept IS at its core — not by its causal role in the edge.

assignments.reason: This node describes the act of purifying one's blood as a prerequisite for speaking truth. Its essential nature is purification-toward-truth — the positive act of refining oneself so that truth can emerge. The source text (line 4) states: 'וֶאֱמֶת אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְדַבֵּר, כִּי-אִם כְּשֶׁמְּזַכֵּךְ מִקֹּדֶם אֶת הַדָּמִים'. Purifying blood is the bodily/physical face of the truth domain — it is what truth looks like in the body. This is not falsehood (Package 1) since it is the opposite of עכירת הדמים. It is not the neutral cosmological structure of post-creation (Package 2) or the intermediary purity/free-will zone (Package 3). It is a positive preparatory act belonging to the domain of אמת and השגחה.

This node describes the state where truth-speech becomes possible (once blood is purified). Its essential nature is the speech-dimension of truth — the verbal expression of אמת. The source text (line 4): 'וֶאֱמֶת אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְדַבֵּר, כִּי-אִם כְּשֶׁמְּזַכֵּךְ מִקֹּדֶם אֶת הַדָּמִים'. This node is fundamentally about אמת — truth in its spoken form. It belongs in Package 4 alongside אמת, כלו אחד, עינים, and השגחה, all of which are faces of the divine truth/unity domain.

This node describes guarding oneself from falsehood — the practical eitza of the Torah. Its essential nature is truth-maintenance, the active preservation of the truth domain. The source text (line 21): 'יִשְׁמֹר עַצְמוֹ מִשֶּׁקֶר, וְעַל-יְדֵי-זֶה הַשְׁגָּחַת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ עָלָיו, וַאֲזַי כֻּלּוֹ אֶחָד'. Although the node references שקר, its essential nature is not falsehood — it is the guarding FROM falsehood, which is an act of truth. The person who guards himself from sheker draws divine providence (השגחה) and achieves oneness (כלו אחד). This node is the practical/action face of the truth-and-providence domain.

assignments.node_id: שיהיה אחר הישות והפעלה שהוציא מכח אל הפעל, שיהיה כלו אחד, שיהיה אב ובן כאחד, כמו שהיה מקדם כשהיה בכח, ישמר עצמו משקר, ועל־ידי־זה השגחת השם יתברך עליו, ואזי כלו אחד
assignments.node_text: שֶׁיִּהְיֶה אַחַר הַיֵּשׁוּת וְהַפְּעֻלָּה שֶׁהוֹצִיא מִכֹּחַ אֶל הַפֹּעַל, שֶׁיִּהְיֶה כֻּלּוֹ אֶחָד, שֶׁיִּהְיֶה אָב וּבֵן כְּאֶחָד, כְּמוֹ שֶׁהָיָה מִקֹּדֶם כְּשֶׁהָיָה בְּכֹחַ, יִשְׁמֹר עַצְמוֹ מִשֶּׁקֶר, וְעַל־יְדֵי־זֶה הַשְׁגָּחַת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ עָלָיו, וַאֲזַי כֻּלּוֹ אֶחָד
assignments.reason: This is a compound summary node encapsulating the Torah's central conclusion: that after creation (אחר הישות), one should achieve total unity (כלו אחד) — father and son as one (אב ובן כאחד) — by guarding from falsehood, which draws divine providence, restoring oneness. Its essential nature is the culmination of the truth/unity/providence teaching. The node references post-creation (Package 2 territory) and guarding from sheker, but its essential nature — what it IS — is the achieved state of divine unity through truth and providence. The goal described is כלו אחד (already in Package 4), achieved through השגחה (Package 4), by means of אמת (Package 4). This is the Torah's positive conclusion, fully within the truth-and-providence domain.
